name: Sagar Cements Ltd
title: Sagar Cements Ltd-$ - 502090 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA/tonne ₹445 vs ₹218 a year ago on cost savings; FY27 volume guided ~7 MT (+15%) with ~₹25/bag hike sticking in South but flat-to-negative in Central/East.

utilisation.quote: Mattampally plant operated at 59% utilisation while Gudipadu, Bayyavaram, Jeerabad, Jajpur and Dachepalli plants operated at 84%, 69%, 95%, 44% and 38%, respectively

capex.quote: our expansion projects at Dachepalli and Jeerabad are progressing and we remain focused on executing these projects within defined time lines and budget

triggers.label: ~₹25/bag hike sticking in South
triggers.quote: we could sustain the same price what we have increased middle of April, even so far, it is holding up

triggers.label: Central/East prices slipping
triggers.quote: It's slightly negative bias in the central as well as in the eastern markets for us

triggers.label: Pet coke cost +₹100–150/t from mid-Q2
triggers.quote: At cement level, it should definitely add close to ₹100 to ₹150 on the current kind of a blend for us

triggers.label: FY27 volume ~7 MT (+15%)
triggers.quote: we expect our volumes to be in the range of around 7 million tonnes for FY '27

guidance.quote: we expect our volumes to be in the range of around 7 million tonnes for FY '27
I think in the current year itself, we should be very close to ₹600 because the significant improvement for us has come from the cost itself
what we do except is off of 30% kind of a margin as a minimum in that business line
we were expecting ₹350 crores spread over two years' time

prior_guidance_check.quote: we ended the year at almost ₹1,550 crore plus

red_flags.label: Net debt overshoot vs guidance (~₹1,550 cr vs ₹1,300 cr)
red_flags.quote: we ended the year at almost ₹1,550 crore plus

red_flags.label: Working capital days up on payables stretch
red_flags.quote: Your working capital days has increased significantly from March '25 to '26 and this is largely driven by decline in payable days

red_flags.label: Recurring mining/MBL cess provisions catch-up
red_flags.quote: it would be accumulated for last 3 years since we started the unit

evasions.topic: Superfine division revenue and EBITDA numbers
evasions.quote: we would revert with very specific presentation pertaining to that in due course of time
we are not pencilling in either of them

evasions.topic: Incremental debt reduction and sources of capex funding
evasions.quote: CapEx may not come from EBITDA alone
